Description: Monitored area of the city centre where visitors were counted.
Date the visitors were present. Includes St Patrick's Day parade days and normal days across multiple years.
Gender of the visitor group. M/F/N (N is none Stated)
Age range of the visitor group.
How long visitors stayed in the location, given as a band rather than an exact duration.
Estimated number of people in this group. Extrapolated from telecoms data to represent everyone in the area, so values are not whole numbers.
Category of visitor. Local is from the Dublin area, Domestic is from Ireland but outside of Dublin or International is from abroad
